newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells 45.5 stake in engineering firm.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells 45.5 stake in engineering firm.

text.p: Croatia's state privatisation agency sold its 45.49 stake in an engineering firm Tehnomont from Pula on Monday, the Zagreb Stock Exchange reported.
A package of 126,343 shares priced at 12.6 million German marks ($7.7 million) was sold to private brokerage Euroatest for blocked hard currency savings.
Payment in these frozen assets that are part of the public debt entitles buyers to a discount of up to 30 percent.
The privatisation agency set an auction next Monday for 22.86 percent in veterinary practice Veterinarska Stanica Klanjec. The firm's total book value is 191,000 marks.

The agency holds cash sales of its minority holdings in mostly privatised firms each Thursday. But it also plans to sell off parts of state-owned utilities such as the Adriatic oil pipeline this year. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 1.636 German Marks)
